title: Unit
description:
One process or container that an app runs, which a plan lists as a unit.
Its path is `/jumpgate/units/<app>/<unit>`.

mxv allows uppercase letters in a unit's name, and a record path holds
none, so a unit's name is lowercase.

app.description: The app that runs the unit.

kind.description: Whether the unit is a process or a container.

name.description:
The unit's name within its app. A record path holds no uppercase
letter, a rule that this schema does not express: the name holds no
uppercase letter.

ports.description: The names of the ports the unit serves.

items.description: Names a port: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter or a digit.

repo.description: The repository the app comes from.

starts_after.description: The units of the same app that start before this one.

items.description: Names a unit: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter or a digit.
